authoritative_timeout_mechanism: GitHub Actions step-level timeout-minutes on the pinned matlab-actions/run-command native acquisition step.
policy: Authoritative native MATLAB execution is performed by the pinned MathWorks Run MATLAB Command action. Its GitHub step timeout is 180 minutes; whole controlled job timeout is 240 minutes, leaving 60 minutes nominal margin for source cleanliness, status finalization, hashing, artifact upload and transport record.
timeout_classification: If GitHub/action metadata explicitly proves native step timeout, classify NATIVE_STEP_TIMEOUT_TOOLING_FAIL. If only a generic failed action outcome is available, classify MATLAB_ACTION_EXECUTION_FAIL; do not infer source nonconvergence or fabricate timeout certainty.
